fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Junior Engineer JE Agriculture Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Junior Engineer (Agriculture) on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 134 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Junior Engineer JE Agriculture Recruitment 2026 has started from 17 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 07 October 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Junior Engineer JE Agriculture Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 September 2026
  • Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 14 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Official Notification
  • Official Website
